# ANALYSIS: WALK_FORWARD_OOS_REALFILLS_VALIDATION_TOP3_J_DAYS

**Filed:** 2026-09-06  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** validation_test  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current engine's edge capture on J's winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) will be positive and within ±15% slippage when validated via walk-forward OOS (6-month held-out) and real-fills, indicating the strategy is not overfit and can generalize to live trading. We also measure edge_capture across all J days (winners and losers) to validate OP-16 compliance.

## Mechanism

1. **Walk-forward OOS test:** Train on 12 months of data (2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28), test on 6-month held-out window (2026-03-01 to 2026-08-31) using the baseline engine configuration (automation/state/params.json and automation/state/aggressive/params.json as of 2026-09-06). This window includes all J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07).
2. **Real-fills validation:** For the top 3 J winner days (4/29 SPY 710P x6, 5/01 SPY 721P x20, 5/04 SPY 721P x10), simulate trades using cached OPRA data with realistic slippage model (bid/ask spread, latency, market impact) to compute actual P&L. Compare to the walk-forward OOS backtest P&L for these days to calculate slippage percentage.
3. **Edge_capture calculation:** Compute OP-16 edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers)) using the walk-forward OOS results across all six J days.
4. **Slippage threshold:** Validate that |(real_fills_pnl - backtest_pnl) / backtest_pnl| < 0.15 for each of the top 3 J winner days.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ account (sufficient to trade the strategy's typical qty without violating the 50% per-trade risk cap). For J days, we use the strategy's actual qty as determined by the engine (not the sample quantities in J's source-of-truth, which are for illustrative P&L only).
2. **Sample bias:** Using 16-month history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 per leaderboard notes) with a single 6-month held-out window (2026-03-01 to 2026-08-31). The test window includes the J days, creating lookahead bias risk if the strategy was tuned to these dates. Mitigation: We will report training window performance to check for consistency; significant train/test divergence indicates overfit.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window test pending execution).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top 3 J days pending execution).
5. **Failure modes:** To be determined post-test (will include worst day P&L, max drawdown during test period, and blow-up scenario parameters).
6. **Concentration:** To be determined post-test (will report % of edge_capture attributable to top 5 P&L days in the test window).

## Pre-merge gate

- Walk-forward OOS test must complete without errors and produce edge_capture > 771 (OP-16 floor).
- Real-fills validation must show slippage < ±15% on all three top J winner days.
- No rule violations in automation/state/params.json or automation/state/aggressive/params.json (current settings must remain valid).
- Test must be run on latest main branch commit (hash recorded in results).
- Gym validators for core components must pass (backtest/tests/).
